source_quote: Here, ES will either hold the 7649 backtest discussed above, OR put in a Failed Breakdown of 7632 (the 530AM low). Next slate of targets are 7803, 7826, 7855.
text: Primary bull path: ES either holds the 7649 backtest or puts in a Failed Breakdown of 7632 (the 5:30AM low), then runs the next slate of targets at 7803, 7826, 7855.

trigger.condition_text: hold the 7649 backtest OR Failed Breakdown of 7632

source_quote: If we remain truly parabolic, there will be no dip down to 7649-7632 and we will just remain in lockout. There is nothing to do in this case, if you are desperate you can watch for flushes and recoveries of 7742.
text: Lockout case: if ES stays truly parabolic there is no dip to the 7649-7632 zone at all and nothing to do. Only a desperate trader watches flushes and recoveries of 7742.

source_quote: At around 530AM, ES at 7632 set a massive low from which we rallied to 7700+. A Failed Breakdown of this low is actionable. Be sure to use the non-acceptance protocol to enter here, entering above 7637 on strength and momentum.
text: The 7632 Failed Breakdown is the one long Mancini actually wants. Enter via the non-acceptance protocol, above 7637 on strength and momentum.

source_quote: There are no supports of interest below until 7549 and there is a complex shelf of lows here... A Failed Breakdown of this entire shelf is actionable (this means you want to see 7542 sweep and then recover 7549 to long).
text: The 7549 complex shelf of lows is actionable as a Failed Breakdown: sweep 7542, then recover 7549 to long.

source_quote: Nothing below there until 7499. We closed here on Friday at 5pm and ES gapped up from here Sunday, creating a large low. A Failed Breakdown of this low is actionable. Bonus if ES tags 7483 on this.
text: A Failed Breakdown of the 7499 gap low is actionable — that is the Friday 5pm close ES gapped up from. A tag of 7483 on the flush makes it better.

trigger.condition_text: flush and recover 7499; bonus tag of 7483

source_quote: Below there is nothing until 7517. If price is grinding slowly into this zone, you can try a bid there.
text: If price grinds slowly into 7517 a bid can be tried there.

source_quote: The first micro support is not until 7707 which is quite a ways down. I won't touch this personally as its too close to the highs but if you really want to trade wait for it to flush and recover. 7673 is below there and same drill here.
text: 7707 is the first micro support and 7673 the next — both flush-and-recover candidates, but Mancini passes on them personally as too close to the highs.

source_quote: Next is 7567. This was a shelf we broke out yesterday morning. One can try the backtest long here, but I won't take this personally.
text: 7567 is the shelf broken out yesterday morning; the backtest long is available but Mancini will not take it.

source_quote: Bulls fully and completely control above 7516 meaning we could sell down there and its only a backtest of a breakout zone.
text: Bulls hold complete control above 7516 — a sell all the way down there is only a backtest of the breakout zone, not a regime change.

source_quote: No remote bear case until 7418 fails.
text: There is no bear case at all until 7418 fails.

source_quote: Below 7632 may be a high risk short though... For the 7632 short, ideally one can put in a final bounce or here, OR a Failed Breakdown then one can short beneath the lows of that bounce. Likely 7624 trigger down.
text: Below 7632 is a high-risk breakdown short, with a likely 7624 trigger down. Mancini does not take these — he expects 80% of breakdowns to trap and over 60% of these trades to fail even when well executed.

source_quote: ES has gone parabolic after breakout out its 1+ week long range at 7516 to 7418. We are now ripping and there is 0 to do but ride a long runner. There are no supports until much, much lower (7710, then 7650). My general lean is ES can simply continue the run to 7803, 7826, 7855.
text: Summary lean: ES has gone parabolic after breaking out of its 1+ week 7516-to-7418 range. Nothing to do but ride a long runner; supports are far below at 7710 then 7650, and the lean is a continued run to 7803, 7826, 7855.

source_quote: We are now at ATH's so shorting makes 0 sense, but for those who just like to gamble and don't mind losing money, 7803 are spots to try.
text: Shorting is off the table on Mancini's own book at all-time highs; he names 7803 only for those who insist on trying.
